assessment.caveat: Assessed value is not market value — do not conflate the two. API version resource; last_etl_update 2026-09-07 on WPRDC metadata. USEDESC is an assessment class, not a Title 9 use.

sales.caveat: Filter using sale-validation codes; many transfers are not arm's-length sales. Only SALECODE=0 (VALID SALE) is treated as a comparable. Quit-claim, sheriff, love-and-affection, and multi-parcel sales are excluded from comps.

construction_cost.citation: Building Valuation Data – AUGUST 2026 (https://www.iccsafe.org/wp-content/uploads/BVD-BSJ-AUG2026.pdf); occupancy R-3 (Residential, one- and two-family), construction type VB; $177.63/sf national average. Not Pittsburgh-specific. ICC: not an estimating guide; excludes land.
construction_cost.national_average_note: ICC states these are average costs based on typical methods, a national average that does not take into account regional cost differences. Regional Cost Modifiers are subject to the authority having jurisdiction.
construction_cost.not_an_estimating_guide: ICC states the table is intended to help jurisdictions set permit fees, not as a project estimating guide.
construction_cost.pittsburgh_modifier_note: The former Bureau of Building Inspection is now the Department of Permits, Licenses, and Inspections (PLI). The 2026 PLI fee schedule (effective 1/1/2026) charges residential permits at $6.00 per $1,000 of construction value (min $130). It does not publish an ICC BVD square-foot table or a local multiplier on ICC BVD. Construction value is taken from the project; it is not a Pittsburgh-specific $/sf schedule.

coverage_notes: Decision support only — not legal, financial, or zoning advice.
Assessed value is not market value — do not conflate the two. API version resource; last_etl_update 2026-09-07 on WPRDC metadata. USEDESC is an assessment class, not a Title 9 use.

Filter using sale-validation codes; many transfers are not arm's-length sales. Only SALECODE=0 (VALID SALE) is treated as a comparable. Quit-claim, sheriff, love-and-affection, and multi-parcel sales are excluded from comps.
Construction $/sf is ICC Building Valuation Data – AUGUST 2026, occupancy group and Type VB, national average. Not Pittsburgh-specific. No City PLI/BBI local ICC modifier was found on 2026-09-26.
Any claim that multiplies ICC $/sf by floor area is estimated, not measured.
Do not guess financing terms, interest rates, or developer profit margins.
Do not assert demand — that is the Demographic Analyst's role.
FINISHEDLIVINGAREA=1704 sf is the existing building size on the assessment record, used only as a size proxy. A different typology would have a different program.
This parcel's recorded transfer is not a VALID SALE (arm's-length filter); do not treat it as a comparable sale price.
